title: Prepositions
note: Dependent prepositions, including every verb in the Verb + preposition list of the 'Preposition checkers' activity (14.3). Each set fills the 27-cell honeycomb on skills/similar-words/prepositions.html. 'p' is the preposition the sentence needs ('Ø' = none); 'alt' lists others also right in that sentence.
